Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't activate if it becomes your opponent's turn before your main phase.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect if an effect at the start of my turn or during my unsuspend phase or breeding phase causes the memory counter to move to my opponent's side and it becomes my opponent's turn?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] 1 of your Digimon with [Gaomon] or [Gaogamon] in its name gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn.
[Your Turn] When an effect adds cards to your opponent's hand, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
